source: Design an open-world simulation game where players paint on walls, doors, and books using real-world paint brands

image_prompt.text: Paintable walls, doors, and shelved books distributed through the world as the stations of the painting loop
Walkable streets and connections chaining the paintable buildings together
Vehicle-width roads through the open world
Buildings whose exterior walls and doors are surfaced to be painted on

layout_placement.text: Interaction stations on each paintable surface where a player applies paint

notes: Open world plus book-scale paint targets spans two scale bands at once; a single region-wide top-down cannot resolve a paintable book, so the book surfaces need a separate room-scale pass.
Real-world paint brands are licensed named products - flagged as a content question rather than a layout feature.
path-road-vehicle came in with the preset and nothing in the prompt calls for vehicles, but it is kept per the take-the-whole-preset rule.

answers.answer: Use a contemporary city setting, matching the real-world paint brands and everyday paintable surfaces.

answers.ask: How big is 'open-world' here - a few city blocks, or a whole town?
answers.answer: Keep it to a few interconnected city blocks for a focused, plainly playable open-world slice.
